summary: Ladder-style 80-foot tower moved from Ash River to Elephant Lake by the CCC in 1940; register and county list disagree on whether it still stands.

facts.status_note: The Forest Fire Lookout Association county list marks it gone; the 2021 register says it currently houses communications equipment

events.note: Stood at Ash River from 1924 (register gives 1924-1935)
Re-erected by the Civilian Conservation Corps at Elephant Lake
Registered January 8, 2021 as US 1481, MN 16; nominated by Jacob Hufnagle

corrections.why: The 2021 register says the tower currently houses communications equipment, but the Forest Fire Lookout Association county list still marks it Gone. The sources conflict, so no status is proposed; check a recent photo or the managing agency before changing the record.

notes_for_editor: Status is unresolved: the FFLOS county list says Gone, while the NHLR 2021 entry says it currently houses communications equipment. Forest Lookouts (Superior National Forest) and NHLR (Minnesota DNR) differ on the administrator. The blog cited in the record returned HTTP 404 and the Star Tribune article returned HTTP 429, so neither was read. The FFLOS county list also shows a separate Ash River tower as Standing (NHLR US 1286, MN 12); not checked whether it is related to this tower's history. No staffing sources were found. Record height_m 24.4 matches the 80-foot figure.
